channel.description: Resources Slides Video Script [00:00] Hello, and welcome to the Week 10 announcements for CIS 527 and CC 510 in Fall 2026. So, this week you should be getting started on Lab 5. The first round of Lab 5 quizzes are due this Friday, as well as your response to the third discussion session that we had last week with Kyle Hudson. So make sure you work on that. This lab actually has two sets of quizzes. So the second set of quizzes on all of the Docker stuff is going to be new next Wednesday on the fourth. And then on Friday, November 6, we’re going to have the fourth discussion session, which we’ll talk about briefly. And you should also be getting graded for Lab 5 by Friday, November the sixth.
